name: x
description: A centered close mark with two balanced diagonal strokes.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner clarified that the Filled box must keep 2px outside clearance and Outline is exactly the X inside that Filled box, following Plus. The upright rounded box spans 2..22 on the native 24 by 24 grid, with radius-4 corners. Its negative-space X and the standalone Outline share diagonal centerline endpoints 4.85..19.15 on each axis, giving visible glyph bounds 4..20. The shared glyph retains Regular-equivalent width 1.70 and .85 round caps. This leaves exactly 2 units between the glyph and each box side, plus 2 units between the box and each artboard side. The cutout is the exact analytical union of the Outline stroke exterior. Both glyphs are centered at 12,12 with identical position, size and contours; no style-specific scaling or translation. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review. The owner subsequently requested rounder Filled box corners: radius is 4, with box bounds, glyph contour, stroke weight and the measured 2-unit side clearances retained.
